The Lich's Transmutation is one of the most rewarding activities in the world of magic.  The benefits you gain far outweigh the price you have to pay.  Chief among those benefits is immortality.  Listed in this thesis are the steps to be taken to become a lich.  Follow them carefully, dear reader, for while following the instructions will bring you limitless power and life eternal, incorrectly following them will take it all from you.
The procedure for the transmutation is as follows:  The subject to become a lich drinks from the Elixir of Defidation (preferably willingly), then steps into the Chamber of Change while the Master-Of-Liches activates the Transmutation Engine.  The Elixir of Defidation rends organs, strips flesh, and separates the soul.  This mixture is collected and deposited in the soul jar.  Once the procedure is complete, the subject will emerge, lich-ified, as it were.
Here are the steps to be followed when becoming a lich:

Kira,
I cannot help but keep you in my thoughts.  You are the loveliest woman I have ever met.  Inside this warrior's heart of mine, you inspire my tongue.  Despite my best efforts, I cannot help but write love sonnets to you.  I've picked the best of them to share with you:
Kira the Cold
She sure is bold
She holds my heart
because she's so smart
If she were with me
All others would flee
I would sacrifice a feather
So we could be together
I would kiss a tree
If she would be with me
She looks better than my horse
Of course? Of course!
I would give her my heart
So we would never be apart

My eternal flame is yours,
Bjarni

Erlend,
I've heard some news that you might not enjoy hearing.  I know what your group thinks of this sort of news, and it is with a heavy heart that I pass it along to you.  The Squirrel of Life, your gift to the Temple of Honk has died.  It was an unfortunate event, but he chose to pick a fight with the geese that live at our temple.  Unfortunately for the squirrel, he was pecked to death, and promptly eaten by our geese.  My deepest condolences.
Yours,
Henford
High Honker
Temple of Honk

Be it known that the bearer of this Writ has seen the Wyrdes, and been judged by them to be worthy of its honor.  The bearers of this Writ have been fated by the Wyrdes to unite the six clans of the Chedian against the Beldonian Hordes led by Tamur Leng.  It is their fate alone to stop Tamur Leng from conquering said clans.

Be it known that the bearer of this Writ has seen the Wyrdes, and been judged by them to be worthy of its honor.  Tamur Leng, 11th direct descendant of Jevar the Bastard, has been fated by the Wyrdes to raise an army in Beldonia. Then take them across Rysh, conquering all they see.  It is Tamur Leng's fate alone to forge a new Ursanian Empire.

Be it known that the bearer of this Writ has seen the Wyrdes, and been judged by them to be worthy of its honor. The bearers of this Writ have been fated by the Wyrdes to imprison the god Njam, also known as The Meddler in the Tomb of a Thousand Terrors in Arslegard.  It is their fate alone, and they shall have the honors of doing it.

Praise be to Honk!  In the years following our prophet's travels across Rysh, the Great Honk saw fit to take him into his arms and reincarnate him as a goose.  As Honk chose not to tell us which of his geese our prophet Philacte Canagica was reborn as, all geese are considered holy.  Rejoice, oh reader, for the time of the Great Honk is at hand, when all shall be equal and will follow the Way of the Bread!
Praise be to the great Philacte Canagica!
Glory be to Honk!!
You have beaten Ivan the Smart in a contest of knowledge.  You may bear this certificate with pride!

Be it known that we the undersigned, in accordance with this treaty, will immediately cease and desist all hostilities, and make every effort to forge peace and unity between our two clans.
Signed,
Bjarni Thorvaldssen
Sigmund the Stressed

Byri,
Your payment has been arranged.  Sven keeps a booth at the Arena, and attends the games there frequently.  I have arranged for you to be a competitor.  You should have no difficulty in finding him and putting an arrow in his chest.  Be subtle.  The last thing we need is for someone to discover who planned this.

HW

My dearest Eloise,
I know your father forbids our relationship, but I find myself thinking of you day after day.  Please, I implore you.  Meet me at our field in Thjorgard.  I have made plans to spirit away to Sturmford to be married.
My undying love,
Hrolf

Hejr Emerssen
Production Accountant

Gunnar,
Because of your recent activities, and your constant refusal to join with the other Thjoradric Smiths, I'm afraid we are going to have to restrict your supply of Elemental Thjorad.  In addition, you will be paying an additional 20 gold per ounce.  You've been a good friend to me over the years, but this is business, and I've got the other Thjoradric Smiths to think of.  I'm sorry to do this, but you've forced my hand.
Atli

The Ritual of Consecration is an old and historic event steeped in tradition.  As far as the record show, priests have been conducting the ritual since before the founding of the Ursanian Empire.  The proper method for conduction the ritual is as follows:
Find the clear section of ground, usually where the cornerstone shall lie.  Go to the nearest tree, and while you are removing the branch, ask for its permission, while blessing it as defined on page 15 of your "Common Blessings" book.  Mix this branch into a large pot of water while giving it the Piety and Prosperity Blessing as defined on page 22 of the "Common Blessings" book.  Once the concoction has been brought to a boil, pour it over the ground where the church shall be constructed while chanting these words:
"As Igdrasa her self has been born from nature, we commit these blessings to the ground set aside for her worship."
When that is finished, surround the area with lit candles for at least one day.

..As Artair Ordway was the founder of the Ta'Sar Academy, it is only fitting that his statue is displayed prominently in the Trophy Room.  According to the documents, drinking from his cup will provide the warrior with his strength, but alas there are many cups in the Trophy Room.  It is also been said that woe be the soldier who tries, for drinking from the wrong cup will bring death a-knocking.

Willian J. Nortley

As it has been said time and again, the unchallenged student will get lazy.  The way to prevent this is to keep the student from idleness.  A good instructor will surprise the student with tests, additional work, and failing all else, a good solid beating.  These forms of motivation have been proven time and again successful in creating a disciplined and hardy student.

..In studying the weapons of this period, it is important to note that the Ursanians have always been at the point of the spear, so to speak, in regards to weapon making.  Most, if not all of their smithing techniques have been lost to time.  One of the more interesting items from this period is the spear known as the "Stouka Couta" or Stick Cutter in our language.  It was the primary weapon of the Persana Garda, the men who guarded the emperor. They were magically enchanted to do three things.  The actual details on their effects have also been lost to time.

..The most effective time to lay siege to a castle is near the end of winter, when the castle's food stores are already low.  Study the lay of the land well, and be mindful of any potential holes in the siege wall, where a messenger might be able to sneak out to call for food or reinforcements.  There is nothing worse than having to fight a castle on one side and invading army on the other.  The goal is to get the castle to surrender, not to be slaughtered yourself.

..Stone fortifications are most effective against an invading infantry.  These barriers lose their effectiveness when the invading army brings with them Mages, or siege equipment.  When planning the defense of any strategic location, one would be wise to use the natural lay of the land.  It is the defender's best ally.

..The most important aspect of gathering information from your enemy is to not reveal your disguise, as the uncovered spy is not only useless, but can in fact be dangerous.  If an agent does not know he has been uncovered, he can find himself working for your enemy by passing along incorrect information believing it to be true.  This is why it is wise to have more than one agent when conduction infiltration.

Gavin,
I have pressing matters to attend to.  If you wish to see the Book of War Rules, please put these books back where they belong.  Once you have completed that, finding the Book of Rules should not be difficult.

Sergeant Magnus

Step One:  Make certain the Transmutation Engine is in working order.  This is very important.  If the machine is not functioning, the results could be unpredictable.
Step Two: Prepare a new batch of Elixir of Defedation.  This is the fluid that identifies which parts of your body will be sacrificed for immortality.  It must be made fresh for each transmutation.  Instructions on how to make the elixir are in the kitchen near the skeleton transformer.
Step Three: Consume the Elixir of Defedation. Subjects becoming a lich must drink from their own vial.
Step Four:  Take your place in the chamber while the Master-Of-Liches activates the Transmutation Engine.  This is the most painful part of the procedure.  Bear it well, dear reader, for the pain is only temporary, but the power you gain will be yours forever.  If for some reason, the Master-Of-Liches is not available, the Transmutation Engine can be remotely activated.

Prepared by Risdar Darksoul

Before you train, keep these important factors in mind, students Choose your class carefully.  Once you have chosen to promote yourself in rank, there is no going back.  I've listed in this, the path you will need to follow to achieve your selected path.
Assassins and Gladiators must start as Fighters, followed by Mercenary.
Rangers and Paladins must start as Fighters, then be promoted to Crusader.
Mages and Liches must start as Initiates, and become Scholars.
Priests and Druids must start as Initiates, and then become Healers.
Once again, choose carefully, for there is nothing more permanant than your class choices.
Training Master Wilrag

Elise had been my love.  That much had always been for certain.  It was unfortunate that the day at the carriage had gone so badly.  I had always wanted to tell her how much she meant to me, and had planned to right there as she was climbing aboard.  How could I have known that her foot would slip when I pulled her back to me?  It wasn't as if the mud had made things that slippery.
I had to put her from my mind.  It was distracting me from my job as Worldly Hero.  I couldn't think of her.  I had to keep my mind on what I was doing.  One misstep and it was all over.
Still, Elise held my heart, I could do nothing without her.  She had always been my reason for being.
"Oops," Enril said.

Must be skilled in fighting
Must have own horse, sword, and armor.

Inquire at the hall of Halfdan the Strong.

To My Children,
I've gone to earn some money to stop us from starving.  Fear not, I shall return soon.
Hatlati

Heroes, LLC
Megan the Mage, President

Ganir the Assassin, Security

Skallgrim,
I've seen you come home late and drunk for the last time.  I've taken up with your brother Janir.  At least he takes me with him when he goes out drinking!  Maybe we'll see you at the wedding.
Cicilia

Have you been to Sturmford?  We here at the Drangheim Defense Force have, and are more than happy to share our experiences with you.
In Sturmford, anyone who is not native is forced to surrender their arms and wear their hair in ponytails!
Their woman all dress like the men, and wear iron-barred masks to keep them in line.
Help us rid the world of these people!
Join at the House of Thrylgrin

Jarl Sigmund,
I really wish you would do something about the Yobboes who have taken up near our village.  They very frequently come into our village and steal things!  Why, they even stole my daughter's dolly!  Please, I implore you.  Send some of your soldiers down to root these people out!
Iosobail A'Norta

To the Kitchen:
The meals as of late have been increasingly foul in flavor.  You know I am not one who makes threats idly.  If you value your jobs, I would suspect you would be doing what you can to better the taste of the meals you deliver to me.
Lord Kluso

My son Nicolai
Things have begun to look very bad around here.  I've heard that Armageddon's Blade has been forged.  I will be traveling soon to Antagarich to try and stop the madness.  
While I'm gone, you will be in charge.  I suspect you are old enough now.  Should anything happen to me, you will become King.
Be mindful of your duties son, and stay vigilant of the Kreegan.  They are still out there, and who knows when their numbers will surge.  If that happens, they will attack again.
As always, you have my love.
Your father, 
Roland Ironfist

The chain shirt known as Poltergiest has been in the collection for years.  After studying it in detail for six months, I can find no concrete evidence for the claims that it was made from ghost, though I did experience some unusual events during that time.
On the fifth day of my research, I thought I heard someone in the laboratory playing with the shirt.  When I returned to the lab, it was about ten degrees cooler than it should have been, and was as empty as I had left it.
On the eighteenth day, during my study of the unusually pale color of the links, I felt a strange hand on my shoulder.  When I turned, no one was there.
On the ninetieth day, Sven, one of my assistants ran screaming from the lab.  He has not been back since.

My dearest Sevanna,
I had the most wonderful time last night.  Maybe I'm too soft for a warrior, but I have always been fond of the moonlit walks on the sand.  I hope it wasn't too much of a bother that I had to unlock my eyes from yours to slay that sea monster.  I'm also sorry I accidentally landed some of its ichor on your dress.  

With all the hope in the world that I shall see you tomorrow,
Nurtigan

Sweet Nurtigan,
Our date yesterday was wonderful.  I really loved the way you dispatched that Nagate without even having to draw your sword.  Your skill with the sword is unmatched.  Please, feel free to call on me at any time.

Your sweetkins,
Loriana
Your true dook has arrived.  Fealty oaths shall be happily accepted throughout the summer and autumn.  If you wish, you may donate money at the front gate of the Dook's castle.

The Frost Giant has once again resumed activity.  It is recommended that you keep track of your children after dark, and under no circumstances should you let them wander near the magic waterfall.

Signed,
Helron Bjarnissen
Watch Commander

Dear Gyira,
I pray that this letter reaches you.  I am still in Frosgard after we parted ways six months ago.  The docks have all been frozen up, and there is no way for a ship to come in or out.  The countryside is too dangerous for me to travel to Thronheim.  I pray that the ice will break up soon, and I shall be able to reach you.

Your friend,

The Green Man
May we say how bold,
Or pray you are not too old
To come again to visit
For a pledge we will give it

Should your return come soon
To bring the flowers...

Dockmaster Streveens,
I've been made away that there is some grain being kept in one of your warehouses.  I've also been made aware that due to your lack of proper handling, some of it has started rotting.  I shall be sending some men over to take charge of the warehouse.  I expect that you will give them your full cooperation, lest I take this up with Jarl Tryygva himself.

Walteir

Henree,
I've had enough with this Temple of Honk!  I've decided that I will use my petition this month to implore Kira to do something about them.  Last night they spent an hour in my tavern preaching their nonsense to anyone who would listen.  I finally forced them to take their mouths elsewhere, but I suspect they'll be returning tonight.  We'll see what Kira will be able to do about them.

Jofridr

Lariee, I've found it!
I found some sort of storage facility from the Old Ursanian Empire!  It must have untold treasures inside!  The words scratched on the door named the place Inventa Storca.  I eagerly await your arrival so that we can excavate it together.  I am certain this place will answer all our questions about the days of the Ursanian Emperors.
See you soon

Jerhildr

Wahng,
I am certain the Temple of Honk has a plot to take over Thronheim.  Why else would they be here?  I've heard them preach to the nobles, and give money to the beggars.  They are up to something, and I intend to find out what.  If you don't hear from me in two day's time, call the Jarl.

Jack

Oh, Igdra
You bring us life eternal
And warm our hearts.
I shall give you your demands.
All my soul
My humility
my chastity
my very life itself
That you might walk beside me hereafter

Dearest mother,
I know you bid me to work my hardest ever, and I try.  Life here is difficult.  I spend my days hard at work in the fields, and all night in prayer at the temple.  I am forbidden from speaking to another soul, not even to acknowledge their presence  
I have not felt this lonely ever.  I long to be warm by the fire, eating the stew you prepared.  The emptiness in my heart would be unbearable, save for the warmth given to it at the beauty of this place.  Perhaps one day, you will find the strength to make a pilgrimage here.  I eagerly await that visit.

Henrolm

Abbot Leffery,
Must we support that musician in our rafters?  I know that he plays the organ during your services, and the music he provides is a wonderful gift from Igdra, but he is intolerable!  I haven't had a nights rest in weeks.  In my dreams I hear the songs he plays.  I can hardly tolerate it.  Please, make it stop!

I've instructed a few of our monks to guard Thjorad while a case is being made to properly display it.  All monks are instructed to not bother any of those who are guarding Thjorad.  They are not to leave Thjorad except to obey the call to prayer.  Please do not make their job any more difficult than it already is.

Abbot Leffery

Dear Kjara,
I am truly sorry about your last visit.  Along with this letter, I shall send a new cart to replace the one that was destroyed by the magic mines.  I know you said that it wasn't my responsibility and that we all live with the threat of the mines, but those mines were on my land.  I beg you to take the cart as compensation.

Gunnar

The Framish Queen has not promised us any soldiers, and I suspect that Freetown may already have been taken.  The sooner we allow these soldiers to come and go, the safer we all shall be.

Mayor Gorge

Our advance scouts have reported that the town of Yorwick should be easy pickings, and could possibly be a strong base to launch attacks into Chedian.  The Grein River is a formidable obstacle, and we should take steps to secure its crossing points.  
Once that is done, securing a supply of Elemental Thjorad should be a mere few months away at most.

The only way we'll be able to get that much money is to take the loan Kira the Cold offered us.  Borrowing from one tyrant to pay another if you ask me! You are a fool, aren't you?  Do you not know what is in the Dark Passageway?  There is a reason Krohn himself had difficulty going through it to meet the Wyrdes.  I am not going to pay for your funeral when you come back dead.  And don't give me that "You're already dead" excuse again, because I'm sure what's in there will find a way to make you dead permanently!

Hafgrim

..That Emperor Trandis is up to something, I'm certain of it!  He had some soldiers out here from their encampment scoping out the terrain.  He'll be in for a shock, that's for certain!  I am the only one who knows where all the traps are.  Should his troops gain entry into my tower they'll certainly not find a way out..
..from the letter I got today.  It was from someone claiming to be my sister!  I will be the first to admit I do not recall anything from my childhood, but I'm certain I didn't have a sister..did I?..
..he claimed to be one of the creatures who created me.  As if I was not born from a womb at all!  He claimed that I was the victim of some bizarre experiments.  I laughed at him..
..I won't back down.  I am sovereign from the Ursanian Empire, and I mean it!  Those soldiers will be sorry on this day!..
..He paid me to give him the thing.  He called it the "Capstone of Order".  I no longer had any use of it.  It was a lot of money, so why not?..
..Perhaps?  I have locked my diary in the study.  It should be safe from prying eyes there!

..I Fear that the RED skeletons have escaped from my control.  I should have known those YELLOW bellied cowards I hired from the Ursanian Army would not be suitable for transformation..
..I don't understand what is wrong with my soldiers.  As the days go on, their attitude worsens.  The other day, one of the division captains told his superior he was feeling BLUE.  Perhaps the power I infused in them has been corrupting their souls..
..and then they fought each other, both because of GREEN envy.  Had I not enjoyed watching them fight, I might have put a stop to it.  It gave the men a laugh though, and I saw more than a few of them bet on it..
..found it in the barbarian region called Cheh'dian.  It was an ORANGE metal, somewhat akin to gold.  During my experiments I found it takes readily to enchantment.  I think I will need to aquire more of this substance.

All miners are to wear their helmets at all times!  There will be no excuses!  If you get hurt because of your neglect to follow the rules, you WILL NOT be given any leeway.  If you have any issue with this, you can take it up with the Senior Foreman himself!

Hrolf Enrikssen
Foreman

The mines are getting increasingly dangerous.  It seems that a few Troglodytes have broken through in the east mine.  Do not engage these creatures!  The Thjorad you produce is too valuable to waste your lives on trying to kill them.

Lari Roles
Linesman

The Drangheim threat has not been abated.  We need to keep to our watches in case they rise up again.  Just because we've sent General Ivsar's army out to meet the Drangheim army does not guarantee that we'll be successful.  Anyone caught sleeping on duty will receive a public beating from me personally!

Captain Wilhem

Captain Wilhem,
As you know, I was ordered to bunk with Sergeant "Stinky" Wilans.  I beg that you have a shred of mercy in your soul and order my sleeping arrangements to be reassigned.  I will even sleep in the storage room!

Corporal Smit

The Commander of the Watch will be conducting random visits all next week.  It is advised to be at your post at all times.  Should you be found away from your post, you may find yourself on the other side of the bars.

Watch-Lieutenant Emilssen

Guya,
I can bear this prison no longer.  The guards have taken to beating me daily.  I don't know how much strength I have left in me.  I've managed to bear it by keeping the image of you in my mind, but it's fading my love.  Included in this letter will be detailed floor plans of the prison.  I beg you please find someone who will break me out!

Atterangi

I know there is great interest in what my soldiers are doing in the caverns below this castle.  I hereby order you to not go down there any longer.  The guards you bother by taking the passage have earned their sleep from being on watch all day.  Suffice to say that you will all be greatly rewarded when I retrieve what is down there.

Thank you for your patience,
Your Dook

My Lord Dook,
For three nights in a row now, the Watch Captain has walked by me while I was at my post and beat me on the head.  He says it's to make sure that I wasn't sleeping, but when I move to make sure he knows I'm not sleeping, he beats me harder for not staying at attention.  I'm not the only guard who has been complaining about this, nor the only one who would be happy if he were fired.

A Concerned Guard

I can assure you, Gavin you will be greatly rewarded if you bring me any of the valuables from the Inventa Storca.  I have great interest in these from a historical standpoint, and I'm certain that others do as well.  It is in your best interest to stop these other parties if you come across them.

L.K.

have read from many credible sources that we have been visited in the past by monsters from the stars who arrived in a flying boat made of metal.  In many of the cases they handed strange devices to people who would eventually lead armies and become rulers of nations.  I wouldn't presume to imply that strange creatures have even visited anyone in the grand history of the Ursanian Empire, but I've heard that rulers of other nations have come to power in such a way.
One credible observer explained that he saw the strange creatures arrive at a place he said was several hundred leagues south of Verhoffin's supposed sovereign tower.  While they were there, they constructed an enormous building with a giant stick that pointed to the sky.  He overheard them tell the person in charge of that province, that when the time came to look to the sky, he would know what to do with it.
Whether any of these claims are true has not been independently verified.  I however am one who takes their claims to heart.  While at a historical site in the Beldonian Province, I saw cave paintings of men fighting demons in the sky.  Why they were, or why they were fighting has been lost to time, but I doubt the primitives who created those paintings could hardly be sophisticated enough to have come up with those ideas on their own.

As I have told you all numerous times before, do not use the skeleton transformer to deposit your experimental waste!  On three occasions now, I've created skeletons who have extra arms growing out of where their eyesockets are, and one had a tentacle growing from its finger.  I am sure this is all amusing to the rest of you, but I will not tolerate it if I catch you!

..I've secured the way to my domination!  I will create a giant army of skeletons.  The machine is here and in working order.  All I need is a constant supply of conscripts, and soon all will bow down to me!  I can nearly taste victory already.  The only one who might stand in my way is that lich who calls himself Pinky.  I am certain he has plans to conquer the world as well..dispatch him..everything would be easy.

I have, for the last time, woken up to a pile of deformed frogs in my washbasin.  Will whoever is responsible for these foul creatures please take care of their behavior?  I would hate for my Giant Magreeb to end up in your washbasin.  He doesn't like these frogs, and who knows how he will react to a constant stream of them.

Hallin, Mage

I probably would have helped him if he had only asked me nicely.  I can assure you though he did not!  Maybe being a few days without a bath will lighten him up.  And then you know what happened..

The interface can be accessed in many ways.  There are a number of shortcut keys that have been set up to go directly to the page that you wish.  Provided you have kept the default configuration, the important shortcut keys are:

'Q' will bring up your QUEST NOTES screen, where all the tasks you have yet to complete will be displayed.
'I' will bring up the INVENTORY screen for the currently highlighted character.
'TAB' allows you to switch between these characters.
'M' will bring up the MAP screen, allowing you to view the map of the area you are currently in.
'N' will bring up your AUTONOTES screen, where important information about the world is kept track of.
'J' will bring up your JOURNAL page, where your great accomplishments will be recorded for posterity. 
'B' will bring up your SPELLBOOK, which allows you to view and cast your spells as well as setting a quick spell.
If you wish to quickly view your entire party, 'Z' will bring up a QUICK REFERENCE view of your entire party.
If you are injured and need to rest 'R' will bring up the REST SCREEN.
'G' will show you information about a monster in your crosshairs. Note: You must have the IDENTIFY MONSTER skill for this to work. 
If you get stuck behind a slow moving peasant, you can always try to get them out of your way by pressing the 'Y' key.

Once you have entered a menu, you can switch between your characters by pressing the 'TAB' key, or you can click on the face of the character you wish to select.  There are tabs along the sides, which when clicked on, allow you to change screens.  If you wish to switch between the CHARACTER INFORMATION and NOTES screens, click on the screen toggle button just above the check button.  This allows you to toggle between the two types of screens.

If you aren't sure what something is or what it does, right-click on it, and you will be provided with a little information on what it is that you are clicking on.

To use or equip an item, double-click on it.  If your character is unable to use or equip any particular item, a dialog box will pop-up telling you why the item can't be used or equipped.  Note that if you already have an item equipped in a particular spot, you will have to unequip it before you can put something new in that slot.

If you have an item that you want to trade to another person in your party, simply click-hold and drag the item over the face if the party member you want to give the item to.

If you want to drop an item from your inventory, highlight it and press the 'DELETE' key.  Be sure you really want to drop this item though, because once it's dropped, it's gone forever.

To use an item in the world, center the crosshair over it and press the 'SPACE' key.

If you have any more questions about the interface refer to the manual.
To continue, pick up and use the scroll called SPELLS to learn about spells.

If you don't have a spell caster in your party, you may skip this by picking up and using the scroll titled "Skills".

You learn spells in the same manner that you would use any other item, by double-clicking on it in the inventory.  If you have any questions about what skills are required to use the spell, you can highlight it and either check the quick info box to the left of your inventory, or right-click on it to obtain more information.

Once your character has learned the spell, they may cast it by opening the SPELLBOOK  (press 'B'), and double-clicking on the spell.  If it requires you to pick a target, you will be presented with a pointer.  Otherwise, the spell will be cast where your crosshair is pointing.  There are a few spell scrolls scattered around if you wish to practice this.

A spell scroll is a one-shot casting of a spell, no previous knowledge of the spell is required.  To use them, double-click, as you would use any other item.

To set your quick spell, open the SPELLBOOK by pressing 'B', and highlight one spell by single-clicking on it.  Then click the button that says "SET QUICK" to set your quick spell.  As long as you have a quick spell set, you may cast it by pressing the right mouse button when that character is highlighted.

If you have any questions on what a spell does, right-click on it in your SPELLBOOK, or refer to the manual.
To continue, pickup and use the scroll titled "Skills".

Skills are one of the most important aspects of the game, and managing your skill points wisely is imperative to being successful.

To learn a new skill, you have to use a skill book by double-clicking on it.  You may find skill books while you are adventuring in the world, or you may purchase them from libraries for a price.

Whenever your characters gain a level, they will be awarded a certain amount of skill points that they may spend to improve various skills.  To spend a skill point, you simply click on the skill you wish to spend it on.  You will need to have at least one more point than the level of skill you have to advance it one rank.

After your character reaches a certain level of skill, they may train that skill up to expert, master, or even as high as grandmaster, depending on the skill and what class they have chosen.  Those levels of skill are 4, 7, and 10 respectively.  To increase your mastery in a skill, you will have to find a teacher who is willing to increase your knowledge in that skill.  These teachers can be found throughout the world.

Here is one tip for finding teachers:  Like-skilled teachers normally can be found in the same town, so the sword expert teacher and the cudgel expert teacher are probably nearby.
To move on, pick up and use the scroll titled "Classes".

It is very important to plan out your character's development early, as once you have chosen a path, you will not be able to go back.  Keep these in mind:

Assassins and Gladiators must start as Fighters, followed by Mercenary.
Rangers and Paladins must start as Fighters, then be promoted to Crusader.
Mages and Liches must start as Initiates, and become Scholars.
Priests and Druids must start as Initiates, and then become Healers.

To continue, pickup and use the scroll titled "Notes".

To help keep track of what you've done, there is a series of pages called the NOTES screens.  To access any one of these screens, see the scroll titled "Interface 1".

The most important of these screens are the AUTONOTES and the QUEST NOTES.  
The QUEST NOTES keep track of all the tasks you haven't finished, and a rough description of what you have to do.  If you ever get stuck, refer to this screen to help you find your way. The AUTONOTES screen keeps track of important things you have discovered in your game, such as where you may find an expert teacher if you've already stumbled across him.  If you ever find yourself looking for someone, and just cannot remember where he is, consult your AUTONOTES screen.

You also have a JOURNAL and an AWARDS page.  The JOURNAL is a living document keeping track of the story thus far.  If you want to know what has been happening in the game, consult the JOURNAL page. The AWARDS page keeps track of some of the major quests you have completed as well as the awards you have received.  If you want to check on the progress of your characters, check this page.

To continue, go to the general store, pickup and use the scroll titled "Shopkeepers".

There are numerous different shops throughout the world, each providing a different service or selection of wares.  To begin a transaction with a merchant, 'use' to begin conversing with him.  Tell him "We'd like to see your wares" or whatever variant of that is offered. He will present you with a new screen.  On the left is the inventory of items he has for sale.  On the right is the inventory of the currently selected character.  Pay attention to who it is conducting the transaction, because it will be that character's merchant skill that will be affecting the price of the items he has.

To purchase an item, double click on the item you wish to purchase, or single click and then press the "BUY" button (the handshake).  If you have enough gold for the item it will be added to your inventory.  If you do not have enough, your character will tell you so.

If you wish to sell an item, follow the same procedure, except with the items in your inventory.  Note that he will probably pay you less for the same item than you would have to pay him for.  To quickly sell an item, highlight it and press "SHIFT-S".

The merchant is also able to repair or identify items for you, if you can't do it yourself.  To do so, click the related button underneath your character portraits (the anvil will repair an item, the magnifying glass will identify it.).  Once you have turned the toggle on, click on the item you wish to repair/identify.

Not all shopkeepers have things to sell.  The banker is a good place to store your gold, you never know when death may exact his price, and if your money isn't in a bank, it's fair game.  If you're injured, the safest place to rest is in town at a tavern.  The innkeeper will rent you a room for a fee. If you wish to conduct any transactions, the tavern is across the street from the general store, and the bank is around the corner.

When you are ready to continue, go to the entrance to the obstacle course, and use the scroll titled "movement".

You are probably already a little familiar with the movement interface, but in case you may have missed something, we'll go over it again.  Here are your basic movement keys:

W: Forward
S: Backward
A: Sidestep Left
D: Sidestep Right
Left Arrow: Turn Left
Right Arrow: Turn Right
SPACE: Use
X: Jump
C: Crouch

The mouse is equipped with mouse-look, meaning when you move the mouse up (away from you) your party will look up, if you move it down (towards you) you will look down.  It may take some time getting used to moving and mouse looking, and if you wish, you may spend some time practicing here.

At times, in order to navigate around an obstacle, you may have to jump over it.  To do this, get a running start, and when the time is right, press the 'X' to jump over the object.  It may take some practice to get the timing right. At other times, you may have to crouch to enter a small hallway, or some other type of crawl space.  To crouch, press the 'C' key, and enter the space.  Spread throughout the world are plenty of ropes and ladders.  To climb these, simple move close to them, look up and move forward.  Climbing down them is a little tricky, and at first you may want to back over the ladder before you look down to stop yourself from jumping off the edge.

You will most certainly be faced with a door you will have to open, a lever you will have to pull, or an item you have to pick up.  To do any of these actions, walk close to the object, center the crosshair on it and press the 'SPACE' key.  This will allow you to interact with whatever object you are facing.  You occasionally see a red or green glow around an object.  This is your perception skill at work.  If it's green, it's a door you can enter.  If it's red, watch out!  A trap may be near.

In various places in the world, you will find a Pedestal of Town Portal.  These were used during the Old Ursanian days when the Emperor needed to move around quickly.  They have fallen into disrepair and have become unusable.  Should you find one of these, you will have to "use" it to clean it off, before you can Town Portal to that location.

When you are ready to continue, you will find the next scroll at the top of the obstacle course.

In all likelihood, you will be faced with a great deal of combat, at times it may be unavoidable.

The first thing you should pay attention to when walking in an unfamiliar place is the gem in the top right corner of your screen.  When it's green, everything is fine, there are no monsters around, and it is safe to attempt to rest.  When it turns yellow, a monster is nearby, or is alerted to your presence.  You will not be able to rest.  If the gem is red, the monster has targeted and is either on his way, or already attacking you.

If anyone in your party has the Identify Monster skill, you may GET MONSTER INFORMATION by pressing the 'G' key.

Once you are in combat, or to attack a monster who is not yet aware of you, you have several options of attack.  You may attack him with the Left Mouse button, which will attempt to attack the monster with a bow or thrown weapon.  If the character is unable to do that, it will attempt to hit the monster.  If the character is unable to attempt to hit the monster, it will block for that turn.  You may also choose to attack the monster with the Right Mouse Button.  This attack is the same as the Left Mouse, except that before the character attempts to do a ranged attack, they will try to cast a quick spell.

You may also enter combat by going into the SPELLBOOK by pressing 'B', and double clicking on an attack spell, or go into the INVENTORY and use a spell scroll on the monster.

Once combat is over, the monsters will bury themselves, and leave behind a treasure bag.  To pick up this treasure bag, use 'SPACE' on it.  If combat gets too crazy, you can enter Turned-Based mode by pressing 'ENTER'.  This slows combat down so you can strategically plan your attacks.  In this mode, everyone gets their own turn to attack.  There are times when this mode will be absolutely necessary in order to succeed.

After combat, when the gem is green you may attempt to rest to get your hit and spell points back by pressing the 'R' key.

If you wish, you can walk across the town to the pasture to practice your combat on the farm animals.  When you are finished with that, you may visit the museum to see a few of the creatures you may face.
When you are ready, visit the Old Man again for your sendoff.

Use the bank.  You never know when you'll lose money.
Talk to everyone.  They may be a valuable source of information.
If it isn't nailed down, take it!
Examine everything.
It's better to specialize in a few skills than generalize.
Plan your character carefully, because there's no going back.
If in doubt, either kill it or run.
There are times when you'll have to use strategy to succeed.
A well-balanced party is your friend.
There are rumors of the existence of black chests.  They are heavily trapped, but well worth the risk.
A saved party is safer than a dead party without a save.  Save your game, and save often.
For useful and important information, check the taverns, temples, and town halls.
Don't forget that the Jarl's have palaces.  They are often a great place to get information and even quests.

Step Three:  Take the Elixir Fluid to the burners, to refine it into the Elixir of Defidation.
Step Four:  Drink the elixir when you are ready to be transformed.

There are six games you can play.  These are instructions on each game.

Ding the Bell.:
Obtain a ticket from the ticket master, and when you are ready to play, click on the base of the bell tower to send the striker to the bell.  If you ring the bell, you win!
Whack-a-honky:
Obtain a ticket from the ticket master, and when you are ready to play, click the start lever.  As the geese move up and down, try to hit them by using them.  If you hit eight or more, you win!
Strongarm the Half-orc:
Standing next to the bell tower is a half-orc soldier who thinks he's tough.  If you are stronger than him, you win!
Runestones:
Obtain a ticket from the ticket master, and when you are ready to play, click on any stone.  The goal of the game is to guess which stone is which color.  click on a colored stone, and then a non-colored stone to transfer its color.  When you think you have the right order, pull the lever.  The stones you have correct will burn.  If you get the order right in four chances or less, you win!
Stones:
Obtain a ticket from the ticket master, and when you are ready to play, click on the game board.  The goal is to prevent your opponent from placing any more stones on the board.  You can only place your yellow stone next to a stone you have already placed.  If you stop your opponent from placing any more stones, you win!
Boat Race:
Obtain a ticket from the ticket master, and when you are ready to play, speak to the boat referee.  The goal is to reach the finish line before your opponents do.  To make your boat move, shoot it with arrow or hit it with your sword.  If you reach the finish line before your opponents you win!
